configurations.name: tutoria-web
runtimeArgs: source .venv/bin/activate && (pkill -f 'uvicorn app.server.main' || true) && (TUTORIA_DB=/tmp/tutoria-dev.sqlite python -m uvicorn app.server.main:app --port 8000 --reload --log-level warning &) && sleep 2 && cd app/web && npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort
